native-conscan-engineering-v1.title: Declared scalar conical-scan optical/electronic design
native-conscan-engineering-v1.note: R=min(width,height)*pitch/2; r=R/2; n=max(1,floor(pi*r/(8*psfSigma))); f=1/(2*pi*n*responseTime).128 phase samples and4x4 spatial quadrature are explicit numerical design. Method references: NAWCWD TP8347(2013),7-1.33-37 and Howser,JHUAPL16(1),1995,27-33. Independent SA-14-only reference: DOI10.1016/j.infrared.2010.07.001,100Hz*12=1200Hz. No OEM AAM constants, fitted scene outcome or empirical calibration are claimed.

method_sources: Katz and Plotkin, Low-Speed Aerodynamics, vortex lattice
Shared aero/model.py, tables.py and mach.py; engineering extensions are not equipment measurements

limitations: Generic AGARD-B geometry, not any of the 88 authored equipment models.
The publication pools facilities/model sizes and includes M0.8/M1.2 runs with the M0.77/M1.17 groups; no common Reynolds condition is supplied.
Body-normal force is derived as CN=CLf*cos(alpha)+CDf*sin(alpha), cancelling axial base-pressure force; reported CZ=-CN.
The 4% biconvex wing uses the existing shared section; its tiny specified leading-edge radius is not separately resolved.
Density/Reynolds and sting/wall interference differences remain. Residuals are not an equipment confidence interval.
No beta, dynamic derivative, powered flow or extreme-angle qualification follows from these conditions.

uncertainty.method: Coupled vortex-lattice/body/section/rate solution, common Mach extensions and common JSBSim tables; retained overrides are listed separately.
uncertainty.table_domain: Actual Mach/alpha/beta bounds are read from the generated product in hangar-vlm.simulation; no narrowing of the authored envelope.
uncertainty.uncertainty_basis: assumed engineering screening range, not measured equipment error or a probabilistic confidence interval
uncertainty.uncertainty_formula: Inside the generic comparison conditions: max(1,2*generic_NRMSE/100); outside them no finite equipment-error bound is established.
uncertainty.boundaries: Generic validation cannot identify equipment-specific separated flow, powered flow, Reynolds effects or extreme-angle errors; those remain unknown.
uncertainty.uncertainty_application: Assumed screening envelope only, not a measured model error or statistical bound. Applies to generic CZ/Cm comparison conditions; no finite equipment-error bound outside those conditions and no calibrated CD/CY/Cl/Cn uncertainty.
uncertainty.input_assumptions: Author-declared geometry and shared section/body correlations. Surface sections, sweep, twist, controls, body stations, mass/CG, analysis speed and all retained overrides are readable in aircraft/aim9m/aim9m.toml. Product extrema are generation coverage, not a validated physical domain.

simulation_model.calibration: Retained native compatibility fixture: seeker V2 and native.warhead.zoned_case.v1 use the original scalar inputs and captured-CG burst. The following production-card model discussion does not select this fixture runtime: AIM-9M Sidewinder is uncalibrated. The Sidewinder-M selects a scalar conical-scan reticle with seven-model shared software optics but its own 85.5 kg geometry, reduced-smoke motor and passive rolleron surfaces. Reticle carrier/background inference is not the old quadrant mechanism or AIM-9X imaging. Retained card anchors: mass 85.5 kg (published; source usaf-aim9; uncertainty 1.0), length 2.87 m (published; source usaf-aim9; uncertainty 0.01), diameter 0.127 m (published; source usaf-aim9; uncertainty 0.002), warhead 9.43 kg (derived; source usn-aim9x; uncertainty 0.2), explosive 3.58 kg (published; source wt-datamine; uncertainty 0.54). Current receiver thermal_conscan_reticle.v1; control fsim.control.load_feedback_cascade; propulsion fsim.propulsion.jsbsim_generated_solid_rocket; fuze native.fuze.swept_path.v1; warhead native.warhead.authored_field.v3. The 9.43 kg warhead entry is a declared cross-variant derivation; exact M reticle/noise, rolleron bearing friction and detonation spectra remain inferred rather than established by the bulk USAF fact sheet. Source classes and uncertainty records remain unchanged; assumed, derived and game-reference values are not promoted to equipment measurements. Per-model theory, parameter deltas and numerical method routes are in docs/research/sim-m03/component-methods/per-model-effects-components.json and per-model-six-components.json; the separate docs/research/sim-m03/calibration-ledger.json identifies the remaining equipment comparisons. Arithmetic or native scenario verification does not establish held-out accuracy. No admitted same-model independent baseline-to-new held-out calibration receipt is claimed; engineering completion continues through its own gates.
